obs: Washington v. Confederated Bands & Tribes of the Yakima Indian Nation

“Although we have stated that the intention to abrogate or modify a treaty is not to be lightly imputed … The intent to abrogate inconsistent treaty rights is clear enough from the express terms of Pub. L. 280.”
"Congress’ 1962 action, we conclude, reflected an unmistakable and explicit legislative policy choice ... We therefore read the statute as having abrogated that treaty right."
